component.name: Maxit
component.summary: AI assistant powered by Ollama, Gemini, ChatGPT and more

description.p: Maxit is an AI assistant that connects to multiple AI services including Ollama, Google Gemini, OpenAI ChatGPT, Anthropic Claude, Mistral, Groq, OpenRouter, and any OpenAI-compatible API.
Maxit is a GPL-3.0-only derivative of Kai by Simon Schubert and contributors. The upstream Apache-2.0 license and attribution notices are retained.
Android, Linux, and Web are maintained. Windows, macOS, and iOS are retained source-only targets.

ul.li: Chat with multiple AI providers from a single app
Run local AI models via Ollama
